sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

You can use your shotgun to blast the undead, and as you progress, you'll unlock new guns and upgrades to enhance your combat experience. The game's levels are designed to be short and intense, with a constant flow of undead to keep you on your toes. Your score is displayed at the top of the screen, and you'll need to beat your high score to progress through the ranks.


One of the game's most appealing features is its increasing difficulty level. As you progress, the undead will become faster, stronger, and more aggressive, making it essential to upgrade your guns and develop advanced strategies to stay ahead. The game also features a 'health' system, where you'll lose lives if you take too much damage. This adds an extra layer of challenge to the game, making it more engaging and immersive.

The game also features a 'grenade' system, which can be used to clear large groups of undead or take out tough enemies. With its addictive gameplay and increasing difficulty level, Undead Walking is a game that will keep you coming back for more.
